A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.

cards.title: Rebuilding Your
cards.body: Most engine suppliers sell you a used engine of unknown history and hope it matches. We rebuild the engine your Land Rover already has instead — strip it down, pressure-test it, and replace every worn or damaged component with updated OEM parts. You get a near-new engine with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty, without the compatibility risk of an unknown used unit. This is the option most TDV8 SDV8 owners choose.

cards.title: Replacement
cards.body: If your existing engine is beyond economical repair, we also offer full engine replacement and fitting — sourced and fitted by our team, with the same 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

cards.title: Used
cards.body: In some cases, a matched low-mileage used engine is the right call — particularly if you need your car back on the road quickly and your existing engine's damage is extensive. We can source and fit these too, though most owners who ask about used engines end up choosing a rebuild once they understand the compatibility risk a used unit carries.

options.body: "Reconditioned" is the term many owners search for when they mean the same thing as a rebuild — a full strip-down, inspection, and replacement of worn parts rather than a straight swap. If that's what you're after, our rebuild service is exactly that.
"Refurbished" often describes the same process from a different angle — restoring your existing engine to full working condition rather than replacing it outright. Our rebuild covers this.

Some owners specifically search for a "remanufactured" engine, expecting a unit rebuilt to original specification with updated components. That's consistent with what our rebuild service delivers, regardless of which of the six TDV8 SDV8-equipped models you drive.

faqLeft.q: What is the Land Rover TDV8/SDV8 engine?
faqLeft.a: The TDV8 and SDV8 are Ford/Land Rover joint-development V8 diesel engines, produced from 2006 to 2019. The 3.6L TDV8 was introduced first, followed by the 4.4L SDV8 (448DT).

faqLeft.q: Which Land Rover models use the TDV8/SDV8?
faqLeft.a: Discovery (L319 D3/D4), Range Rover (L322/L405), and Range Rover Sport (L320/L494) — see the full applications table above for exact variants and years.

faqLeft.q: Does the TDV8 differ from the SDV8?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The TDV8 is a 3.6L engine with lower power output and known timing chain issues on early models. The SDV8 is a 4.4L engine with higher power output and is considered more durable.

faqLeft.q: Is a TDV8 from one Land Rover model compatible with another?
faqLeft.a: Not automatically. 3.6L vs 4.4L variants differ significantly, and specific ancillaries, mounting, and ECU/DME software differ by application. We always confirm compatibility by registration/VIN.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Land Rover TDV8/SDV8 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £4,500, regardless of which model it's fitted to. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.
Yes. We work on TDV8 and SDV8 rebuilds across every model it's fitted to, replacing worn components as standard.

faqLeft.q: What are the common issues with the TDV8/SDV8?
faqLeft.a: The 3.6 TDV8 is known for timing chain tensioner issues on early L322 models. The 4.4 SDV8 has known HP fuel pump failures and turbocharger failures (circa 120k miles). EGR valve sticking and auxiliary belt tensioner weakness are also confirmed issues.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild a TDV8 from a Range Rover?
faqRight.a: Yes. The TDV8 in the Range Rover is one of the applications we work on regularly, spanning L322 and L405 generations.

faqRight.q: Can you rebuild an SDV8 from a Range Rover Sport?
faqRight.a: Yes. The SDV8 in the Range Rover Sport is one of the applications we work on regularly, across L320 and L494 chassis.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Land Rover TDV8/SDV8 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Land Rover if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a TDV8/SDV8 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your vehicle arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most TDV8/SDV8 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history — a particular concern given the differences between 3.6L and 4.4L variants — and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.
